body:
PROBLEM. `packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/record.mjs:91` (inside `buildRedTestScaffold()`) auto-generates a RED test scaffold for every confirmed gate-bypass defeat, but the scaffold body is a stub: `// TODO: Set up a git repo, apply this diff, run ${target}` landing as `t.todo('Implement RED test from repro: .adlc/gate-defeats/${id}.json')`. The repro artifact (diff + setup + witness, written by `writeReproArtifact()` to .adlc/gate-defeats/<id>.json) already contains everything needed to reproduce the bypass mechanically, but nothing currently consumes it to materialize a real, asserting test. This was flagged in issue #68 as the same 'auto-generated scaffold vs. real enforcement' gap in spirit as prosecute's coverage thinness (the issue this ticket was split out from), and tracked there as a linked checklist item rather than implemented in the prosecute-coverage-split PR.

GOAL. Replace the `t.todo(...)` stub with a harness that: (1) creates a scratch git repo (or worktree) seeded from the target gate's fixture state, (2) applies `defeat.diff` and runs any `defeat.setup` steps, (3) invokes the target gate binary and asserts its exit code flips from 0 (defeat, pre-fix) to 2 (caught, post-fix), and (4) cleans up the scratch repo. This can live in `buildRedTestScaffold()` itself (emit real assertions instead of prose comments) or as a shared helper the generated test imports (e.g. `lib/repro-harness.mjs`) so every future scaffold gets it for free.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
AC1 - A `node --test` run of a scaffold generated by `buildRedTestScaffold()` for a known synthetic defeat no longer reports a `todo` result; it reports pass/fail based on a real assertion. Verify: generate a scaffold for a fixture defeat, run it under `node --test`, and grep the TAP/JSON output for the absence of a `todo` marker.
AC2 - The harness actually exercises the target gate binary end-to-end (git repo setup, diff apply, run, exit-code assertion) rather than asserting something trivial or always-true. Verify: a fixture defeat with a diff that is NOT yet fixed makes the generated test FAIL (not todo, not pass); the same fixture with the gate patched to catch it makes the generated test PASS.
AC3 - No regression in `packages/gate-fuzzing`'s existing 10 per-concern test files. Verify: `cd packages/gate-fuzzing && npm test` exits 0.

CONTEXT. Split out of issue #68 (prosecute-coverage-split), which addressed the prosecute test-file-split half of that issue; this ticket tracks the issue's second, separate ask (the gate-fuzzing repro-harness TODO) so it isn't lost. Suppressions are denied.
title: Wire the gate-fuzzing repro-harness TODO into a real RED test (record.mjs:91)
